amendment: Selection amended on 2026-10-15 after seeing calibration seed 1 and before any report seed. The pre-set constraint (recall at ±5 at most 5 points below R0's) is degenerate: R0 at ±5 flags most GT-correct members, so its recall there carries little information and only rules that over-flag as much can meet it. The rule is now the one with the highest Youden J = recall − error at ±5 on the calibration seeds (ties within 0.5 point go to fewer changes). Also amended at the same time: neighbour sweeps keep static boxes as structure (the first version dropped every box, leaving the ±5 sweeps without any occluder), and 16 + 16 seeds instead of 4 + 4 (GT-wrong members are scarce).
